qa_notes: Cover headline is 'FOR LEASE' above the address; captured as transaction 'For Lease' and eyebrow left '' to avoid printing it twice. Change eyebrow to 'For Lease' if the template wants the literal headline.
Title: PDF cover '13810 LOOKOUT ROAD, SUITE B'; Prismic title '13810 Lookout Road' (omits Suite B).
Price mismatch: PDF Pricing '$13.00/SF/YR NNN ($3.10/SF/YR Est)'; Prismic total_price 'Contact Broker' and price_per_unit null. Prismic transaction_type is null though the PDF is clearly For Lease.
Size: PDF office +/- 1,340 SF + warehouse +/- 2,890 SF = +/- 4,230 SF (adds up); Prismic size_label '4,230 SF' (match).
Zoning: the PDF has no zoning, utilities, flood plain or demographics rows; Prismic zoning is also null. No Demographic Overview page in this package (demographic_overview null).
Size and Building Features are each printed as two separate lines on the cover; kept as two lines joined with '\n' rather than collapsed (collapsing Size would read '...2,890 SF Total space is...').
Traffic Count cites the 'Texas State Highway Department' (obsolete agency name; other packages say 'Texas Department of Transportation'); transcribed as printed.
'2 GL OH Doors' = two grade-level overhead doors (broker shorthand); transcribed as printed.
Page 7 (Property Disclosure Statement) is image-only with no text layer; its address prints 'ROGERS RANCH PKWY, STE. 125'.
Page 4 layout defect: a stray duplicate map image sits mostly off the bottom of the page (a sliver shows below the footer) and a second 'Area Map' label is hidden behind the frame.
